# Usage Pulse · 峰谷用量
> 本地开发备忘（怎么改、改完怎么生效、踩过的坑）：见 NOTES.md。
A DSH Web UI plugin that keeps DeepSeek's **peak / off-peak pricing**, your **token spend** and your
**hourly usage** visible right below the composer — updated live, no page reload.
一个 DSH Web UI 插件：在输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek 的**峰谷时段与价格**、**token 用量与花费**，以及**分时用量图表**。
## Features · 功能

- **Live regime badge** — `峰时` / `谷时 5 折` with a countdown to the next price switch, computed in
Bei

jing time (`Asia/Shanghai`), including Chinese statutory holidays (peak is Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00
and 1

4:00–18:00, holidays and weekends are always off-peak).
- **When the cheap window starts** — the exp

ando shows the next off-peak window (`下一谷段 今天 12:00
开始 · 4 小时后`) and when the current segment began,

and while peak is running the pill itself shows
`谷段 12:00 起`.
- **Today at a glance** — today's spe

nd in CNY plus total tokens, refreshed every 5 seconds.
- **Session breakdown** — expand the pill to

see this session's requests, tokens and cost, plus the
cache-hit / cache-miss / output split and ho

w much of today's spend happened in peak vs off-peak
hours.
- **Hourly & daily usage** — 24 one-hour

bars (amber = peak hours) and the last 7 days, so you can see
when you spend.
- **Official unit pri

ces** — the current tier's CNY / 1M-token prices for `deepseek-flash` and
`deepseek-v4-pro` (peak an

d off-peak are exactly ×2 / ×1).
- **Bilingual UI** — 中文 / English through the harness locale servic

off-peak are exactly ×2 / ×1).
- **Bilingual UI** — 中文 / English through the harness locale service.
## How pricing is computed · 计费口径

Prices follow the official page <https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/> (verified
2026-
10-22, CNY per 1M tokens):
| Model | Band | Cache hit | Cache miss | Output |

| `deepseek-flash` | peak | 0.04 | 2 | 8 |
| `deepseek-flash` | off-peak | 0.02 | 1 | 4 |
| `deepsee

Peak = Beijing time **Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00**, excluding Chinese statutory holidays.
E
verything else (nights, weekends, holidays) is off-peak, at exactly half the peak price.

Usage is read from the harness session event feed (`assistant/message` → `usage`), where
`inputToken

s` already excludes cache hits: `cost = miss·missRate + hit·hitRate + output·outRate`
(`cacheWriteTo

kens` is billed at the cache-miss rate). Estimates only — Search / Fetch request fees
are not includ

are not included.
## Privacy · 隐私

Only aggregates are stored, never conversation content: per-hour counters (tokens and cost) and
per-

session totals, kept for 35 / 120 days respectively and capped at 300 sessions. The file lives at
`~

/.dsh-usage-pulse/usage.json` (override with `DSH_USAGE_PULSE_DIR`). All computation is local; the
w
idget talks to the host over a same-origin route only.
## Install · 安装

This repository is a DSH plugin bundle: `package.json` declares the `dsh.bundle` manifest and
`cordi
s.patch.yml` inserts the plugin, so it installs the same way as any other plugin.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

For a local checkout, point the DSH plugin manager at the directory containing `package.json`
(`plug

in_manager install_bundle` in the Web UI). No restart is needed: the widget appears in the
composer
dock right after install.
## Files
| File | Purpose |
| `index.js` | Host half: event aggregation, pricing, persistence, `GET /usage-pulse/api/snapshot` |

| `client.js` | Client half: composer-dock widget + detail panel |
| `holidays.js` | Chinese statut

ory holidays (off-peak days) |
| `locale/` | Bundle metadata (zh / en) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Load
er patch that inserts the plugin |
## Notes
- Peak-regime accuracy depends on `holidays.js`: add the next year's State Council holiday list once

it is published (usually the preceding November). A stale list only mislabels holiday days.
- Usage

that happens while the plugin is disabled is not backfilled (the persisted session log is a
concate
nated zstd frame stream that Node cannot decode frame-by-frame reliably).
